questions.korean: 저 사람이 내가 어제 만난 남자야.
answers: That's the man who I met yesterday.
That's the guy I met yesterday.
This is the book that I was looking for.
This is the book I was looking for.
I have a friend who is good at English.
I have a friend that speaks English well.
That's the car that I wanted.
That's the car I always wanted.
This is the restaurant that my friend recommended.
This is the place my friend suggested.
Turn off the light.
Please turn off the lights.
questions.explanation: turn on = 켜다, turn off = 끄다

answers: Don't give up.
Never give up.
She takes after him.
She looks like him.
questions.explanation: look like도 닮다는 의미지만 외모 비교에 더 많이 씀

questions.korean: 미팅을 내일로 미뤄야 할 것 같아.
answers: I think we need to put off the meeting until tomorrow.
We might have to postpone the meeting to tomorrow.
He showed up out of nowhere.
He showed up suddenly.
Would you mind closing the window?
Do you mind closing the window?
questions.explanation: mind + ~ing: Would you mind 뒤엔 반드시 -ing

questions.korean: 나는 집에 있는 게 더 좋아.
answers: I'd rather stay home.
I would rather be at home.
Would you mind if I waited here?
Do you mind if I wait here?
questions.hint: Would you mind if I + 과거동사?

questions.korean: 나는 걷는 것보다 드라이브하는 게 더 좋아.
answers: I'd rather drive than walk.
I'd prefer to drive rather than walk.
Would you mind turning down the music?
Could you turn the music down?
I was so tired that I couldn't walk.
I was too tired to walk.
questions.explanation: too ~ to = so ~ that ~ can't (같은 의미)

questions.korean: 영화가 너무 재미있어서 두 번 봤어.
answers: The movie was so good that I watched it twice.
The movie was so interesting that I saw it twice.

questions.korean: 그는 너무 빨리 말해서 이해할 수가 없어.
answers: He speaks so fast that I can't understand him.
He talks so quickly that I can't follow him.

questions.korean: 그것은 너무 비싼 가방이어서 살 수 없었어.
answers: It was such an expensive bag that I couldn't buy it.
It was so expensive that I couldn't afford it.

questions.korean: 날씨가 너무 더워서 밖에 나가기 싫어.
answers: It's so hot that I don't want to go outside.
It's so hot that I don't feel like going out.

questions.korean: 나는 두 시간 동안 공부하고 있었어.
answers: I have been studying for two hours.
I've been studying for two hours.
questions.explanation: 현재완료 진행: 과거부터 지금까지 계속되는 동작

questions.korean: 그는 아침부터 비디오 게임을 하고 있어.
answers: He has been playing video games since morning.
He's been gaming since morning.
How long have you been waiting?
How long have you been here?
We have been living here for two years.
We've been living here for two years.

questions.korean: 그녀는 최근에 운동을 열심히 하고 있어.
answers: She has been working out a lot lately.
She has been exercising hard recently.
I think so too.
I agree with you.
questions.hint: I think so, too. / I agree.

answers: I have no idea.
I don't have a clue.
questions.hint: I have no idea = 전혀 모르겠어
questions.explanation: don't have a clue = 단서조차 없다 (구어체)

answers: No way!
That's unbelievable!
questions.explanation: That can't be true! / You're kidding!도 가능

answers: I'm happy for you.
Good for you!
questions.hint: I'm happy for you = 너를 위해 기뻐
questions.explanation: Good for you! = 잘 됐다 (상대방에게 좋은 일이 생겼을 때)

answers: To be honest, I'm not sure.
Honestly, I'm not certain.
questions.explanation: To tell you the truth도 같은 의미

questions.korean: 내가 새라면 어디든 날 수 있을 텐데.
answers: If I were a bird, I could fly anywhere.
If I were a bird, I would fly everywhere.
questions.hint: If I were + 명사, I would + 동사원형
questions.explanation: 가정법에서 I는 was 대신 were를 씀

questions.korean: 돈이 더 많다면 집을 살 텐데.
answers: If I had more money, I would buy a house.
If I had more money, I could get a house.
questions.hint: If I had + 비교급, I would + 동사원형

answers: I wish he were here.
If he were here, things would be better.
questions.hint: I wish + 가정법 과거 (현재 사실과 반대 소원)

answers: If I were you, I would apologize.
If I were in your shoes, I'd say sorry.
questions.hint: If I were you = 내가 너라면

questions.korean: 거기에 살지 않는다면 방문하고 싶을 텐데.
answers: If I didn't live there, I would want to visit.
If I weren't living there, I'd love to visit.
questions.hint: If + didn't + 동사원형, would + want to

answers: That project is a piece of cake.
That project is easy as pie.
questions.hint: a piece of cake = 매우 쉬운 일
questions.explanation: easy as pie도 같은 의미의 이디엄

answers: It's raining cats and dogs.
It's pouring outside.
questions.hint: raining cats and dogs = 비가 억수같이 오다

answers: Don't spill the beans.
Don't let the cat out of the bag.
questions.explanation: let the cat out of the bag도 같은 의미

answers: Let's start fresh.
Let's turn over a new leaf.
questions.hint: start fresh / turn over a new leaf = 새 출발
questions.explanation: turn over a new leaf = 새 출발하다 (관용어)

answers: He is set in his ways.
He is very stubborn.
questions.hint: set in one's ways = 고집이 세다

answers: He said that he was tired.
He said he was tired.
questions.hint: said + that + 시제 한 단계 과거로

answers: She said she would come tomorrow.
She told me she would come the next day.
questions.explanation: tomorrow → the next day로도 바뀌기도 함

answers: He told me to wait.
He asked me to wait.
questions.hint: told me to + 동사원형 (명령 → told to)
questions.explanation: told to = 명령, asked to = 요청

questions.korean: 그녀는 거기 간 적이 있다고 했어.
answers: She said she had been there.
She told me she had visited there.
He said he loved you.
He told you that he loved you.
I have been working at this company for 10 years.
I've worked here for 10 years.
questions.hint: 현재완료 or 현재완료 진행형 + for 기간

questions.korean: 만약 내가 더 어렸다면 더 열심히 공부했을 텐데.
answers: If I were younger, I would study harder.
If I were younger, I'd work harder.
questions.hint: 가정법 과거: If + were, would + 동사원형

questions.korean: 그가 보낸 이메일이 매우 도움이 됐어.
answers: The email that he sent was very helpful.
The email he sent was really helpful.

questions.korean: 솔직히 말하면, 나는 그 영화가 좋지 않았어.
answers: To be honest, I didn't like the movie.
Honestly, I wasn't a fan of the movie.
questions.explanation: wasn't a fan of = 좋아하지 않다 (구어체)

questions.korean: 그녀는 조용히 해달라고 부탁했지만 아무도 듣지 않았어.
answers: She asked everyone to be quiet, but nobody listened.
She told everyone to be quiet, but no one paid attention.
questions.hint: asked to + be quiet + but + nobody/no one
